name: AB Weather
reason: No verified Weather Shortcuts workflow is available. Current, hourly and daily queries use the permitted native WeatherKit fallback in the signed Mac Helper.
qualification: WX-SIM qualifies the injected runner. WX-REAL exercises public WeatherKit queries and checks units, attribution, counts and plausible ranges without storing coordinates. Real reads need an Apple-signed Helper with com.apple.developer.weatherkit and a matching WeatherKit-enabled provisioning profile. When the services development profile is installed, the dev Helper embeds it and uses its matching application identifier, WeatherKit entitlement and Apple signing certificate.
